description.value:
Trigger Pressure is applied to the floor tiles

Effect The trap shoots a wave of darts targeting the entire area as a single attack. Creatures in the affected area take @Damage[(4d8+10)[poison]|traits:nonlethal]{4d8+10 nonlethal poison} poison damage and must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:21] save. The trap also triggers an audible alarm.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 2}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 3}.

details.description: Hidden launch tubes fire darts filled with anesthetics at a 10-foot square.
